mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO business_card_import_request (workspace_id, idempotency_key, request_fingerprint) VALUES (#{workspaceId}, #{idempotencyKey}, #{requestFingerprint})
mapper.select: SELECT request_fingerprint AS requestFingerprint, person_id AS personId, attachment_id AS attachmentId, company_id AS companyId FROM business_card_import_request WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND idempotency_key = #{idempotencyKey}
mapper.update: UPDATE business_card_import_request SET person_id = #{personId}, attachment_id = #{attachmentId}, company_id = #{companyId}, completed_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND idempotency_key = #{idempotencyKey} AND person_id IS NULL AND attachment_id IS NULL
